sentences.text:
This Court while granting interim protection to the applicant vide order dated 07.03.2024 has passed the following order:-
"1. Learned AGA informs that he has procured complete instructions in the matter including up-to-date case diary and the investigation of the case is still going on.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Adarsh Rawat Alias Adarsh Kumar in Case Crime No.0136 of 2023, under Sections 409, 420, 504, 506 and 120-B I.P.C., Police Station- Aliganj,
District- Lucknow, with the prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail as he is apprehending arrest in the above-mentioned case.
4 . Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the anticipatory bail application submits that it is a case of false implication.
The allegations which have been levelled in the first information report, are false, concocted and could not be believed.
5. It is vehemently submitted that though, allegations have been levelled that the applicant apart from others has also transferred some rupees in the Bank accounts of his wife.
However, till now, no evidence or material has been collected by the Investigating Officer, which may suggest that any amount has been sent by the applicant in the bank account of his wife.

6. It is further submitted that whatever money has been transferred by the applicant,
the same has been transferred under the instructions of the informant.

7. It is further submitted that the instant proceedings have been initiated against the applicant in retaliation to a proceeding initiated by the wife of the applicant against the informant of the instant case and other accused persons as an application under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C. was moved by the wife of the applicant against the informant- Vikas Agrawal and two other accused persons, which has been treated as complaint.
8. It is also submitted that the applicant is not having any criminal antecedents.
He is ready to cooperate in the investigation and would remain present before the Investigating Officer as and when his presence would be required.
9. Learned A.G.A. on the other hand opposes the prayer of anticipatory bail of the applicant.

10. Considering the fact that it appears to be an admitted situation that till now, no material or evidence has been collected by the Investigating Officer, which may Adarsh Rawat Alias Adarsh Kumar vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57421081/
2 suggest that any amount has been sent by the applicant in the Bank account of his wife, his personal liberty may be protected till the next date of listing, while granting an opportunity to the informant of this case to file objection/ counter affidavit.

sentences.text: 11 . Thus, issue notice to the informant of the instant case i.e. Vikas Agrawal S/o late Sitaram, R/o D-2/ 549, Sector F, Jankipuram, Lucknow North, U.P., returnable till the next date of listing.
12. Steps in this regard be taken by learned counsel for the applicant within three working days from today.

13. List this case on 29.03.2024.
14.

Learned AGA has submitted that investigation in the matter is going on, however, he could not show from the material on record that the applicant is not cooperating in the investigation and has not misused the liberty of bail granted by this Court.

On due consideration to the fact that the applicant has no previous criminal history as well as reason recorded in the order dated 07.03.2024 the interim protection granted by this Court is made absolute in view of dictum of Apex Court in re: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98.
